title: feature request:   add import/export option
line: Sticky notes can now be exported to an HTML or text file and imported back from one, from the note's context menu.
explanation: The Sticky Note widget kept its text only in its internal storage, with no way to save a note to a file or load one, so backing up or moving notes meant copying and pasting by hand. The change adds "Import from File…" and "Export to File…" to the widget's context menu: export writes the note as HTML (keeping formatting) or plain text depending on the chosen file type, and import inserts an HTML or text file's contents at the cursor.

commits.message:
applets/notes: add actions to import and export a note

There was no way to save a note to a file or to load one, which makes
backups and moving notes around tedious. Two new actions in the widget's
context menu export the note as HTML or plain text and import such a file.

BUG: 517220

media.caption: The note's context menu only offers colors and the usual widget actions.
Import from File… and Export to File… at the top of the note's context menu.
Export Note dialog, HTML or text file type, starting in Documents.
Two new empty notes after importing the exported HTML (formatting kept) and text files.

review.text: Adds Import and Export actions to the note's context menu with standard FileDialogs. Export uses a QSaveFile helper, writing HTML or plain text by suffix; import inserts at the cursor, escaping text files. Compact, fits the applet (which already reads dropped files via NotesHelper), and the media show a round trip. The error dialog shows the raw URL path without percent-decoding; that's cosmetic.
